name: Fluoxetine
summary: Fluoxetine is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressant.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Hepatic demethylation, involving CYP2D6 and other pathways, produces active norfluoxetine. Both persist for a long time and undergo further metabolism before predominantly renal elimination of metabolites.
